UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE
SOIL CONSERVATION SERVICE
P. O. Box 648
Temple, Texas 76501
March 25, 1976
Mr. Gordon Walhood Chief, Engineering Division Department of the Army Fort Worth District, Corps of Engineers P. O. Box 17300 Fort Worth, Texas 76102
Dear Mr. Walhood:
This is in response to your letter dated March 16, 1976, requesting environmental impact information on the proposed hydroelectric generators at the Amistad Lake.
Currently, the land around the lake is used primarily as rangeland with some residential built-up. In the future, rangeland will continue to be the major land use; however, some rangeland will be converted to residential development.
Sincerely,
George C. Marks
State Conservationist
